transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm... well, I'm here about work. The warehouse. The routing system there... it's not just a computer anymore. I know it's been marking my moves. Sending messages through the scanners. Trying to push me out because I'm... because I'm one of the old hands.
How long have you believed that the warehouse routing system is sending you messages and trying to push you out?
A while. I guess... maybe a year and eight months. That's when I started hearing the voices, and... when I figured out what the scanners were doing. Yeah. About that long.
Were you using any recreational drugs when the voices first began?
No. I don't... I don't use anything like that. Just my regular coffee. That's all.
Have you been diagnosed with a medical or neurological condition?
No. I... I don't have any conditions like that. My health is fine.
How has your belief about the routing system affected your ability to do your job?

Well... they took me off the forklift. After... an incident. Put me on leave. Said I wasn't safe around the equipment anymore. And... at home, it's just hard. My wife does the bills now. And the appointments, the chores... I just can't keep up with it all.
Do you hear the voices when you are away from the warehouse and not thinking about the routing system?

Yeah... I do. 

I'll just be sitting out in my garage, you know? Got everything shut off. Just trying to be quiet. But... I still hear them. Clear as day. It's the dispatch voices. They just keep calling my operator number... saying I'm dangerous. Or that security is coming to get me.
Do the voices ever talk about things that are unrelated to the warehouse or your belief that people are trying to remove you from your job?
No... no, it's always about work. Or... them coming for me. It's just the dispatch. Nothing else.
Do your thoughts ever feel so jumbled that it becomes difficult for you to organize what you want to say?
No... I don't think so. I can say what I mean. It's just... I don't always feel like talking much.
How often do you hear these voices?
I'm not sure. I don't really sit there and count them. It just... happens a lot, I guess.
Besides your belief about the warehouse routing system, have you had any other unusual beliefs that other people say are not true?

No... just the warehouse. Like I said... it's not just a computer to me. I know it marks my moves. It sends messages through the scanners... trying to push me out because I'm one of the old hands. But... no. Just that. Nothing else.
Outside of the warehouse situation, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying your usual activities?

Yeah... I guess. I don't do much lately. Fishing... choir practice... even just tinkering with some wood out in the garage. Those things used to settle me. But now... I can look right at my rods or my tools and... I just feel no pull to touch them.
How much of your day do you typically spend hearing these voices?

I don't know exactly. Most of it. Even when I'm just sitting out in the garage... everything shut off, quiet... I still hear them. It's the dispatch voices. Clear as day. Calling out my operator number... saying I'm dangerous. Or that security is on their way to get me. So... a lot of the day.
